title: Playboy Magazine May 1980 Stewardesses Pictorial Gay Talese Interview Miss World
conditionDescription: Cover shows light wear with rubbing along the spine and corners. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, May 1980 issue. Cover price $2.50.

Features:
- Stewardesses! A glorious pictorial
- Playboy Interview with Gay Talese
- Miss World pictorial
- America's Islam Connection
- The Toughest Job in Sports

Stewardess cover. The back cover carries a 1980 Crown Royal ad.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage. Cover shows light wear with some rubbing along the spine and corners. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
